excluded_constructions.reason: Ancestor age >=3 is false; crossing the current age <3 condition would change that ancestor.
CD2/CD25/CD30 expression is categorical; the old 20% threshold is not supplied by this condition or its quoted source.
The condition requires resection-specific ICG limits and an integrated reserve assessment; the old universal 0.1 cutoff does not encode it.

The rewritten condition says residual >=60% but equates it with resection <40%, disagreeing at equality; varying resection also changes an ancestor's resection-dependent reserve assessment. No unambiguous single-indicator pair is retained.
Excluding all listed alternative causes is a conjunction, not a numerical count >=8; no original numerical threshold exists.
The original condition requires an exact every-two-week schedule, not a numerical threshold with a same-side control.
Ancestors require age outside 16-60 and age not >60, which entails age <16; a crossing pair cannot preserve both.
Ancestor already requires platelets <50; crossing the same <50 condition changes the ancestor.
Adequate individual response after AVPC is not the population percentage achieving CR; the old 92% cutoff is inapplicable.
HR-HPV infection is an individual categorical test result; a population clearance rate of 86.7% is not its threshold.
'Mainly seen at gestational age <35 weeks' is not a necessary-and-sufficient definition of preterm RDS; the old age-only threshold does not encode the complete condition.
